mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_space_invitation_table (space_id, token_hash, created_by, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, status) VALUES (#{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{tokenHash}, #{createdBy,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, #{maxUses}, 0, 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pcd_space_invitation_table WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND status = 'active' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND used_count < max_uses LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pcd_space_invitation_table SET used_count = used_count + 1, status = IF(used_count + 1 >= max_uses, 'expired', status) WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId} AND status = 'active' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND used_count < max_uses
